node.title: Re^3: Splitting a long row with multiple delimiters.
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
But getting <undef> as value

Is your Perl 5.12 or earlier, that is, more than six years old? There apparently was a bug with (?| ) that was fixed in v5.14 ([https://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/commit/fd4be6f07df0e6a021290ef721c5d73550e0248c|this] appears to be the commit). You should consider upgrading.

i am unable to understand regex!

Are you familiar with concepts such as non-capturing groups (?: ) and other basics like \s* etc.? If not, you probably want to read [doc://perlretut] first. In fact, as far as I can tell even the advanced regex features I used are explained there (with more details on each in [doc://perlre]):

  • (?| ) - [doc://perlretut#Alternative-capture-group-numbering]
  • (? ) - [doc://perlretut#Named-backreferences] (see also [doc://%+])
  • (?<= ) and (?! ) - [doc://perlretut#Looking-ahead-and-looking-behind]
